precepts.text: Paul took Timothy, whose father was a Greek, and circumcised him because of the covenant.
precepts.point: The Egyptians did not practice circumcision; they were a nation of uncleanness, and the covenant was between the Lord and Israel: after the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do.

note.label: Exodus 4: The Three Signs and the Covenant of Circumcision

precepts.why:
Paul came to Derbe and Lystra and found Timotheus, “the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek”. “Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.”

Paul circumcised Timothy because of the covenant. Timothy came to the truth grown, with a Greek father, and still the covenant of the flesh had to be kept; the same everlasting covenant that the Lord sought to kill Moses over still stands in the New Testament.

precepts.text: Paul and Silas were dragged before the magistrates, beaten with many stripes, and cast into prison.
precepts.point: Every man of the Most High went to prison, from Jeremiah, John, and Christ himself to Paul and Silas, as every man who fought oppression was jailed; the teacher who pushes prophecy is counted the same threat.

note.label: Acts 5: All Things Common, and We Ought to Obey God Rather Than Men

precepts.why:
Paul and Silas after the apostles: their accusers “caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers, And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city, And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.”

“And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely”. Beaten and jailed for teaching customs not lawful for the Romans.

From Jeremiah and John and Christ himself to Paul and Silas, every man of the Most High went to prison. What the forefathers suffered will come again under America, the last kingdom, and worse, so if you teach this gospel, you cannot be joined to this world.

precepts.point: A church just means a gathering or assembly of people. Paul visited Galatia in Acts 16:6 when they went through the region of Galatia, and in Acts 18:23 he went back to strengthen the disciples there.

note.label: Galatians 1: Paul's Apostleship and the True Gospel

precepts.why:
A church just means a gathering or assembly of people, and Paul knew the assemblies of Galatia because he had been there. “Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia.”

That is Paul's visit to Galatia: he went through the region on his journey, and the brethren he writes to, the Israelites congregating in Galatia, are the ones he found there.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why:
“Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,” Meaning Asia Minor. You got to pause there: the spirit did not want them to teach in Asia Minor at that time. At that time. Acts 19:26 proves that sometime later the spirit said to Paul and them, now it's time to preach throughout Asia. But at that time the Holy Ghost said do not go there; now is not the time, there's nobody going to wake up at that time, you have to wait till later. That's why sometimes we want to go to certain places and the spirit be like, there's a block, we can't get there.

“After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia:” They wanted to go into Bithynia. “but the Spirit suffered them not.” The spirit blocked them: no, don't go there either. “And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas. And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us. And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.”

See that? So the Lord will sometimes block your way from certain areas, certain regions, certain countries, certain states: don't go there, there's nobody there yet, I want you to go here. We got to do things in God's time.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 3 A Message to The 7 Churches

precepts.why: Timotheus was mentioned with Derbe. “Then came he to Derbe and Lystra:” Here we go, Derbe again. “and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:” So the mother followed the laws of Moses, and then she believed, accepted Christ; but his father was a Greek. That is always the stipulation, and the Greeks are dealt with in 2 Maccabees.

moments.label: Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East

points: Muhammad said an angel came and gave him the revelation of the Quran. Remember the scripture said we sacrificed unto devils. Now watch: a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying. She was a witch; the same way Balaam had the spirit of divination and could see things in the future, this woman had a devil on her and could see things. The demon in her followed Paul and cried, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation. The demons in her knew who they were.

note.label: Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East

points: Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her; and he came out the same hour. What did Paul rebuke? The spirit. There are evil spirits that have these kinds of powers, to certain limits. Muhammad claimed to have revelations; I would not be surprised if evil spirits were dealing with him. Not just the white man has the spirit of a devil. Remember the scripture: if an angel or anybody tells you anything different, do not listen, because it could be the Lord proving you; and if they tell you something and it comes to pass, still do not follow them, because the Lord is proving you to see whether you will trust in him or in that devil.
